skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG equal to 105% of Max HP to a single target with a 3-hit combo, with each hit additionally dealing 110% of original Max HP as [True DMG]. Has an 80% chance to penetrate [Buffer] (Hellfire UR’s buff). Each hit can trigger [Specialized Breakthrough] once. [True DMG]: Not affected by DMG Rate or DMG Free, and deals Direct DMG without [DMG Sharing] or [Evasion]. [Specialized Breakthrough]: Instantly removes [DMG Ignoration].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG equal to 135% of Max HP to a single target with a 3-hit combo, with each hit additionally dealing 145% of original Max HP as [True DMG]. Has an 80% chance to penetrate [Buffer] (Hellfire UR’s buff). Each hit can trigger [Specialized Breakthrough] once. [True DMG]: Not affected by DMG Rate or DMG Free, and deals Direct DMG without [DMG Sharing] or [Evasion]. [Specialized Breakthrough]: Instantly removes [DMG Ignoration].

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. After any character other than self is defeated for the first time, increases own [Revenge] count by 1, up to 4 times. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. After any character other than self is defeated for the first time, increases own [Revenge] count by 1, up to 4 times. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. After any character other than self is defeated for the first time, increases own [Revenge] count by 1, up to 5 times. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Gains [Revenge] at battle start. [Revenge]: If any character is defeated after an action, this unit immediately resurrects, restores 80% HP, and performs a [Revenge Pursuit] on any target with 150% Special Skill power. This skill is not affected by [Specialized Fear]. Initially has 4 resurrection counts.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Gains [Revenge] at battle start. [Revenge]: If any character is defeated after an action, this unit immediately resurrects, restores 100% HP, and performs a [Revenge Pursuit] on any target with 200% Special Skill power. This skill is not affected by [Specialized Fear]. Initially has 4 resurrection counts.

effects.desc: The bearer only takes a portion (e.g. 20%, or 0% when enhanced) of all damage taken.
Status returns downed units to battle, granting a limited number of respawns that anti-revive effects can remove.
This type of bonus damage is dealt on top of attacks, is reduced by Evasion-type effects, and can be immune after a certain number of turns.
The counterattack state can extend the duration on yourself or shorten it on enemies, granting retaliatory effects.
